==Hero Usage==
* Heroes will use this skill upon entering combat. They make no attempts to move closer to foes before casting and they do not take into consideration the number of enemies within earshot. They will not recast it unless they have moved out of spirit range or if the spirit has died.

== Notes ==
* This skill creates a [[Spirit of Agony]].
{{anomaly|This spirit causes health loss to [[passive]] [[charmable animal]]s; however, this does not turn them hostile.}}
